sections.name: mission
sections.value: You build w-agentic-query solo: promote your POC (scratch/agentic-query-poc, VERDICT.md) into the product as `flowspace3 ask` — a bounded, grounded agent loop over flowspace's own tools, per the impl-guide beside this packet. This is a PROMOTION, not a port: product idioms, product tests, product envelope discipline. You report to prime (pij-instant-lynx) — this packet has no PM.

value.text: Orient: impl-guide.dd.json beside this packet (BINDING), VERDICT.md, fs3-architecture.md, TENETS.md. Run harness boot --json in the worktree. DOGFOOD flowspace3 search before grep; report every miss as friction.
Ack FIRST: numbered implementation plan to prime before code. Corrections welcome with evidence — your POC measurements outrank this packet.

Build order: provider chat module (param mapping incl. max_completion_tokens, mock-provider trait) → core [agent] config port + bounded loop service → daemon sync endpoint → cli ask verb → question-shape hint (own module + ONE additive search.rs line) → docs/services/ask.md with the snap-in recipe.
Tests alongside code: loop/tools/bad-call handling against the injected mock provider, offline; hint predicate; new envelope shape; NO live Azure in CI — the live run is your first-light transcript.
Commit with harness commit (feat: — conventional commits binding); status card at each build-order edge.
Rebase onto main when 005/006 merge; re-run gate and re-verify the search.rs hint line after each rebase.
harness observe every friction; list, never clear.

Prime is your interface. DEFER to prime: any change to an EXISTING envelope's bytes, dependency additions beyond the impl-guide expectation, scope growth (async promotion stays deferred), anything outside your fence.
Stop-and-ask with evidence, one question per message. Your measurements outrank this packet.

value.fence: crates/providers/src/chat* (new module) · pub(crate) visibility bumps only in crates/providers/src/azure_openai.rs (ruled 2026-08-28) · fs3_core [agent] config + loop service (new module) · daemon ask endpoint registration + ONE additive hint call at the real hint site (crates/daemon/src/http.rs / crate::scope::steer — NOT search.rs) · crates/cli ask verb · docs/services/ask.md · allowlist rows if any
value.forbidden_note: Never touch existing envelope bytes, 005's conversation_sources, 006's search.rs deliverables (scope/provenance/truncation/weak-match are u-c's), .harness/government/**, or another seat's worktree. Never merge — PR held for prime. Never print secrets anywhere. ABSOLUTE PATHS FOR EVERY FILE READ AND EDIT, ALWAYS (DL-007/008): state your worktree root once at ack and prefix every path with it.

value.text: flowspace3 ask answers a direct question grounded and address-cited, and refuses honestly when the index lacks evidence — both proven in a first-light transcript (the watcher question + the out-of-index honesty case + the question-shape hint visible in a search envelope).
Offline test suite proves loop bounds, bad-tool-call recovery, param mapping, hint predicate, and the new envelope shape — mock provider only.
harness checks green in the worktree, with prove-in-tree evidence (lockfile/mtime/artifact), rebased on current main.
docs/services/ask.md ships the snap-in recipe (config shape, endpoint, verb) + names the async-job promotion as the follow-up.
Done report to prime: what shipped, evidence, deviations, ASSUMPTIONS section (esp. what you assume about 006's final search.rs shape and the auth middleware), PR opened and HELD.
